rows.text: Crrk crrk! It's the big hand of {RUBY_B#Zagreus}the two-faced thief{RUBY_E#}. Why is it trashing my humble home? Why do they have to disrupt my peace and quiet?
rows.speaker: Tranquilfly

rows.text: No, the walls just vanished out of thin air... Don't tell me that's the black tide? I need to flee! Quickly!
rows.speaker: Tranquilfly
